title: A smooth ring map lifts along square-zero ideals
statement: Let $\varphi:A\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings such that $H_1(L_{B/A})=0$ and $\Omega_{B/A}$ is a projective $B$-module ($H_1(L_{B/A})$ and $\Omega_{B/A}$ as in [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map] and [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials]; this holds in particular when $\varphi$ is smooth [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map]). Let $D$ be a commutative ring with a ring map $A\to D$, let $N\subseteq D$ be an ideal with $N^2=0$, and let $q:D\to D/N$ be the quotient map. Then for every homomorphism of $A$-algebras $g:B\to D/N$ there is a homomorphism of $A$-algebras $f:B\to D$ with $q\circ f=g$.
